recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Use Claim.supportingInfo with the hospitalized category and timingPeriod for hospitalization periods; do not restore the retired standalone element. Any future admission/discharge category-code expansion should proceed through UTG/THO, not this closed core tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-7320 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for DSTU1. It requested admit and discharge date-time support for Claim because service dates might not capture the whole hospitalization, and the final resolution said to add a 0..1 Claim header hospitalization Period.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-7320-tagged git commit was found. The historical Claim update 649fcd4cbf21557ae6db78e0afb908f3030dad7a added Claim.hospitalization 0..1 Period with a Period in hospital label in the Claim spreadsheet, matching the accepted resolution.
additional_context: Later Published issue FHIR-13826 removed standalone Claim and EOB hospitalization fields and represented the information through the information/supportingInfo structure using the hospitalized claim information category and timingPeriod. R4 refactoring renamed Claim.information to Claim.supportingInfo. The combined branch already contains efadbcfd8350e31147a8869617165b8b1b57dd33 auditing that later decision, and unresolved UP-691 is only a draft UTG proposal for broader category-code harmonization.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current build-scope Claim source binds Claim.supportingInfo.category to claim-informationcategory, permits Period in Claim.supportingInfo.timing[x], and examples show hospitalized timingPeriod values. Re-adding Claim.hospitalization would conflict with the later published FHIR-13826 disposition.

related_jiras.note: Published FM issue that removed standalone Claim/EOB hospitalization fields and moved the fact into information/supportingInfo. It is already represented on the combined branch.
Unresolved UTG proposal draft for broader claim information category harmonization, including possible admission/discharge date codes; not final source-edit scope for this reconciliation.
